strongestOverlapAreas: Motion (STEP 3.5 dim 13, sceneTags, subTags all rich and consistent)
Time of day (sceneTags' single richest category by occurrence, 550 total)
analysis.mood_keywords vs catalog moodTags (near-identical concept, incompatible storage)
biggestRedundancyProblems: subTags is 48% genre by frequency-weighted occurrence, duplicating music_profile.primary_genre/secondary_genre
Three different fields all named 'energy' (catalog energy, music_profile.energy_score, analysis.energy) with no reconciliation
dark/bright/warm/cool/soft moodTags conflate literal visual/sonic property with emotional metaphor
biggestMissingDimensions: No narrow seasonal range vocabulary anywhere (no early/late/mid- for any season)
No storm/snow/overcast/humid/clear vocabulary anywhere in the catalog despite these being named STEP 3.5 weather values
No analysis.weather output field exists at all in GptResponse despite STEP 3.5 evaluating weather
Saturation, Contrast, and literal Dominant palette detail have no track-side analogue anywhere in the repository
summary.mostImportantWarning: Duplicate copies of the literal same recording (same youtubeVideoId) carry different energy, moodTags, sceneTags, and subTags depending on which lane they were filed under -- of 22 duplicate-videoId groups, 2 differ in energy, 16 in moodTags, 18 in sceneTags, 21 in subTags. This is direct proof the existing tags encode lane narrative, not inherent track properties, and must not be treated as ground truth for automated atmosphere-stat generation without human review.

step35Dimensions.name: Scene/subject
step35Dimensions.promptWording: street, room, cafe, ocean/water, car, airport/train/platform, concert, selfie/portrait, food, friends, couple, skyline, road, nature, club/party, store/convenience store, study/desk, hotel/window view, or other
step35Dimensions.definition: The primary depicted scene or subject category of the image.
ambiguities: A track has no depicted scene/subject; sceneTags on tracks describe an evoked scene, not a literal depicted one.

step35Dimensions.name: Weather feeling
step35Dimensions.promptWording: sunny, rainy, cloudy, foggy, snowy, humid, dry, stormy, or clear
step35Dimensions.definition: The perceived weather condition, when outdoors/visible.
ambiguities: Catalog vocabulary has zero coverage for snowy/stormy/humid/dry/overcast/clear despite these being named prompt values.
No analysis.weather output field exists at all -- weather is evaluated in STEP 3.5 but not captured anywhere in GptResponse.

step35Dimensions.name: Brightness
step35Dimensions.promptWording: dark / dim / soft / bright / very bright
step35Dimensions.definition: Visual luminance -- how light or dark the image looks, independent of mood (explicit in-prompt distinction).
ambiguities: Catalog moodTags dark/bright conflate literal luminance with emotional tone -- exactly what this dimension's prompt text tries to keep separate.

step35Dimensions.name: Saturation
step35Dimensions.definition: Vividness of colors in the image.
ambiguities: No track-side analogue found anywhere in the catalog vocabulary.

step35Dimensions.name: Contrast
step35Dimensions.definition: Difference between the brightest and darkest areas of the image.
ambiguities: Dynamic range is a plausible external musical analogue but is not present anywhere in this codebase's vocabulary -- an unverified conceptual leap, not repository evidence.

step35Dimensions.name: Color temperature
step35Dimensions.definition: The overall warm/cool cast of the image's lighting and color.
ambiguities: warm (76 occurrences) and cool (40 occurrences) are among the most frequent moodTags in the whole catalog but are heavily conflated with emotional warmth/stylish coolness rather than isolated as literal color temperature.

step35Dimensions.name: Dominant palette
step35Dimensions.promptWording: blue-white, amber-orange, pink-purple neon, beige-brown, green-natural, monochrome, sepia/film, pastel, high-contrast black, or mixed colorful
step35Dimensions.definition: The single most dominant color palette category of the image.
ambiguities: Catalog has no equivalent controlled palette vocabulary; would need to be built from scratch to have a track-side counterpart.

step35Dimensions.name: Light quality
step35Dimensions.promptWording: direct sun, diffused window light, golden hour, neon, fluorescent, candle/warm lamp, overcast, low-light, flash, or screen light
step35Dimensions.definition: The source and quality of the dominant light in the image.
ambiguities: sceneTags already has a reasonably rich light-quality vocabulary but it's mixed in with location/object terms rather than isolated as its own axis.

step35Dimensions.name: Texture/finish
step35Dimensions.promptWording: clean digital, glossy editorial, grainy film, hazy blur, soft focus, noisy low-light, analog snapshot, or polished commercial
step35Dimensions.definition: The visual processing/finish style of the image.
ambiguities: 'editorial'/'commercial' require aesthetic/stylistic judgment beyond pure visual measurement.

Superficial wording overlap with audio production-texture subTags (lofi/polished) is a false-friend risk -- image texture and audio texture are not evidenced to be the same concept anywhere in this repo.

step35Dimensions.name: Visual density
step35Dimensions.promptWording: minimal, cozy clutter, busy city, crowded social, wide-open, or compressed/enclosed
step35Dimensions.definition: How visually dense/cluttered vs. sparse the image composition is.
ambiguities: Musical arrangement density is a real, plausible analogue, but catalog vocabulary on both sides (visual and audio) is too sparse to reuse directly.

step35Dimensions.name: Composition energy
step35Dimensions.promptWording: still, balanced, playful, cinematic, fast, intense, or chaotic
step35Dimensions.definition: Visual dynamism -- density, movement, rhythm, framing intensity in the shot itself, explicitly NOT musical energy (in-prompt distinction).
ambiguities: 'playful'/'cinematic'/'intense' require interpretive judgment, not raw visual measurement.

The prompt itself already flags that a mismatch between this and energy_score 'is a signal worth noticing, not an error' -- i.e. two energy-like concepts exist even within the image-analysis side alone.

step35Dimensions.name: Openness
step35Dimensions.promptWording: enclosed room, semi-open window, street, wide-open landscape, car interior, transit space, or crowded indoor
step35Dimensions.definition: The spatial openness of the depicted scene.

step35Dimensions.name: Motion
step35Dimensions.promptWording: static, slow walk, driving/cruising, fast motion, dancing, performance, travel/departure, or resting
step35Dimensions.definition: Visible or clearly implied physical movement in the image.
ambiguities: 'Implied' motion for a still photo is an inference, not a direct observation.
evidence: docs/music-atmosphere-vocabulary-audit.md section D dimension 13 -- strongest shared candidate of all 14 dimensions

step35Dimensions.name: Social context
step35Dimensions.promptWording: alone, couple, friends, crowd, public space, private space, or unclear
step35Dimensions.definition: The social configuration of people visible or implied in the image.
